decisions.evidence: PocketClinic focuses on offline execution and explicitly leaves external grounding for future work.
PocketClinic is an on-device Medical QA assistant built on a 3B Small Language Model.
PocketClinic shows that LoRA-QA can bring a 3B Small Language Model to a private hospital tablet.
The adapter rank is selected to fit a hospital tablet GPU.
PocketClinic begins with a 3B Small Language Model and applies LoRA-QA.

decisions.limitation: Performance gap remains with full fine-tuning
decisions.evidence: PocketClinic reaches approximately 80% of CuraLM-70B's accuracy.
